attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The company is enumerated — twenty-seven men named one by one, with patronymics, birthplaces and the months of their deaths — so it is twenty-seven folders and not one, by docs/CORPUS.md §10.1. Nothing in the corpus answers to any of these surnames: a grep of `saints/` for all twenty-seven returned nothing, and no folder mentions Kharkov except `meletius-of-kharkov`, a bishop of the eighteen-hundreds. His own head line reads «Αγιος Ιωαννης ο Ιερομαρτυς, ο Διακονος (; - 1937)», and his sentence in the page's list is quoted whole in the life. The body's 1941 is recorded; the page's head lines carry two deacons called Ιωάννης, both «(; - 1937)», and for this one the head and the body do not agree. He is not the other John of the same list who was a deacon and died in October 1937, `john-timonov`, nor `john-feodorov-of-tambov`, whose surname the page spells differently and whose death it puts in August 1937.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
